finalText:
**Bigger than it looks: 94 files, ~1082 lines.**

Four places it must not change:

| Where | Why |
|---|---|
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml) | Public contract, breaking |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/query.js) | Generated, `vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `migrations/*.sql` (12) | Applied history, breaks down steps |
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Right side is the wire name |

Also the SQL column stays `account_id`. Repo files hold it in query strings, as in [order.js:10](services/orders/src/repo/order.js:10). Changing it needs a new migration plus a backfill.

Safe scope is JS names in 75 service files. I can do that pass now.
